For a well-known company with sites in Belgium, Spain, Canada, and France, we are looking for a Night Shift Operator for the site in Bredene.

As a OPERATOR NIGHTSHIFT in the Bredene region, you will be responsible for:

  • Receiving deliveries of ingredients;
  • Setting up, starting, operating, and changing over a production line;
  • Ensuring a smooth handover between shifts;
  • Monitoring production orders;
  • Recording production data;
  • Cleaning and maintaining the machines;
  • Troubleshooting operational issues yourself and notifying the technical department in case of more complex technical failures;
  • Assisting the packing team when required.
As an OPERATOR NIGHTSHIFT in the Bredene region, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

  • You have a solid background as an operator;
  • You are motivated to work in the food industry within a production environment;
  • You are willing to work in a fixed night shift (21:00 – 05:00);
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client in the OSTEND region, we are looking for an ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN.

Our client is an international leader in high-tech solutions for the defence industry. The company develops autonomous underwater drones that detect, identify, and neutralise naval mines.

As an ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN in the OSTEND region, you will play a key role in repairing, testing, and validating electronic assemblies.

Thanks to your expertise, the electronic systems of our underwater drones operate reliably and meet the highest quality standards.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Diagnosing faults in electronic assemblies;
  • Repairing PCBs at component level;
  • Performing precision soldering (SMD and through-hole);
  • Repairing electronic components according to established quality standards;
  • Accurately documenting analysis and repair results;
  • Supporting the testing, validation, and rework of electronic assemblies.
As an ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN in the OSTEND region, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

  • You have strong knowledge of electronics;
  • You have experience in electronic diagnostics and component-level repairs;
  • You have experience with SMD and through-hole soldering techniques;
  • You are able to read and interpret technical schematics and drawings;
  • You are computer literate (Linux and MS Office);
  • Knowledge of IPC 610, IPC 620, IPC 7711 and IPC 7721 is a plus;
  • You have a good command of English; knowledge of French is an advantage;
  • Administrative follow-up does not scare you.

For our client in the OSTEND region, we are looking for a MECHANICAL TESTER/FAULT FINDER.

Our client is an international player in high-tech solutions for the defence industry. The company develops autonomous underwater drones that detect, identify, and neutralise naval mines.

As a MECHANICAL TESTER/FAULT FINDER in the OSTEND region, your responsibilities include:

  • Checking the functionality of electronic assemblies on underwater drones;
  • Detecting faults and defects at cable and PCB level;
  • Identifying the root causes of faults and contributing to effective solutions;
  • Accurately updating production files and test reports;
  • Contributing ideas for improvements within the assembly process;
  • Ensuring the quality and reliability of underwater drone systems.
As a MECHANICAL TESTER/FAULT FINDER in the Ostend region, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

  • You have a technical education in mechanics, electromechanics, shipbuilding or mechanical engineering, or equivalent experience;
  • You are patient and analytical, with a strong eye for detail when troubleshooting;
  • You are interested in precision assembly work, such as cabling;
  • You have broad technical and mechanical knowledge and are eager to continue developing your skills;
  • You are able to read and interpret technical drawings;
  • You work accurately and pay close attention to detail;
  • You speak Dutch OR English OR French;

Our client, located in Veurne, has been an established name within the transport sector for many years.

This family-owned company has grown over the years into a strong player with an extensive fleet and a professional logistics operation.

For their yard, they are looking for a MOBILE CRANE LOADER/UNLOADER who will be responsible for loading and unloading trucks and containers.

Your responsibilities as a MOBILE CRANE LOADER/UNLOADER in the Veurne region include:

  • Operating a mobile crane for loading and unloading trucks and containers;
  • Moving materials and goods;
  • Loading and unloading containers in a safe and efficient manner;
  • Checking the correct operation of the crane and equipment;
  • Ensuring a safe and clean working environment on the yard;
  • Working closely with drivers and colleagues within the logistics operation.
As a MOBILE CRANE LOADER/UNLOADER in the Veurne region, we are looking for someone who meets the following requirements:

  • Experience operating a mobile crane;
  • Technical insight and the ability to work safely with machinery;
  • You work accurately and independently;
  • You are responsible and have a strong focus on safety;
  • You speak Dutch, English, or French;
  • Physical work does not scare you.

For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN.

Our client is a well-established company with years of experience in providing sustainable energy solutions. With a strong passion for technology and technical installations, they are committed to helping build a greener future. Would you like to contribute to the transition towards renewable energy in Belgium and neighboring countries? Then keep reading!

As a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN in the Veurne region, your responsibilities will include:

  • Connecting solar panel installations, home battery systems, and/or EV charging stations;
  • Installing the inverter and providing the required AC and DC cabling according to industry standards;
  • Connecting the AC and DC cables to the inverter;
  • Making any necessary modifications to the electrical distribution board;
  • Completing the single-line electrical diagram to ensure the technical inspection can be carried out;
  • Commissioning the complete installation and providing the customer with clear instructions and explanations on its operation.

As a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

  • You hold a valid Category B driving licence;
  • You have a strong electrical background (experience with solar panels is an advantage but can be taught);
  • You are able to read and interpret technical drawings with ease;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You have a strong focus on safety and always follow the correct procedures and regulations.

Do you enjoy working outdoors and take pride in creating beautiful terraces, driveways, and garden paths?

For a family-run landscaping company in the Koekelare region, we are looking for a FLOORER who delivers high-quality outdoor projects with great attention to detail.

Your responsibilities as a FLOORER in KOEKELARE:

  • Installing terraces, driveways, and garden paths;
  • Laying paving stones, natural stone, ceramic tiles, and other types of outdoor paving;
  • Preparing and levelling the ground;
  • Installing kerbstones, edging, and finishing materials;
  • Working with a variety of machines and hand tools;
  • Collaborating with colleagues on complete landscaping projects.



As a FLOORER in the Koekelare region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have experience installing terraces, driveways, or other types of outdoor paving;
  • You work accurately and have an eye for high-quality finishing;
  • You are willing to work outdoors;
  • Basic knowledge of plants and an affinity with greenery and landscaping are a plus;
  • You speak Dutch OR English.

Do you enjoy keeping machines running smoothly? 
Then this technical challenge might be the perfect fit for you!

For an international chocolate producer, we’re looking for a maintenance technician to support the production department. You’ll be part of a skilled team ensuring the reliability and efficiency of the machinery through preventive maintenance and troubleshooting. You work closely with fellow technicians, line operators, and supervisors, reporting directly to the technical supervisor.

Your mission: keep everything running like a well-oiled machine — literally.
 - Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues on machinery and tools.
 - Perform preventive maintenance on equipment and installations.
 - Assist in machine setups and technical interventions.
 - Contribute to technical improvement projects.
 - Maintain order, cleanliness, and safety according to standards.
 - Follow lockout/tagout procedures during maintenance.
 - Manage production-related side streams (waste, recycling, ...).
 - Participate in internal quality and safety training sessions.
 - Carry out and register required quality inspections.

Are you the hands-on technician we’re looking for? 
Apply today – we’d love to meet you!
- Vaardigheden:
You have a technical secondary diploma (A2).
You have at least 3 years of experience in a production environment.
You have solid knowledge of electromechanics.
You work well independently and as part of a team.
You are accurate, quality-driven, and safety-conscious.
You can set priorities and take initiative.
You work hygienically and pay attention to order and cleanliness.
You’re eager to learn and professional in your communication.
You’re willing to work in a nightshift schedule.
Knowledge of pneumatics and cooling systems is a plus.

- Attesten:
No specific certificates required.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
A2 diploma required (preferably electromechanics).

- Vakkennis:
Experience with industrial machinery, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance.

- Talenkennis:
Good command of English is required.

For our client located in DIKSMUIDE, we are looking for a CNC SETTER.

Our client is a technical and innovative company active in the manufacturing industry. They offer a family-oriented working environment and are committed to investing in both technology and their employees.

As a CNC SETTER in the DIKSMUIDE region, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Setting up and programming CNC machines (mainly 3-axis lathes);
  • Producing unique pieces based on technical drawings (limited series production);
  • Setting up and programming CNC machines;
  • Reading and interpreting technical drawings prepared by the engineering department;
  • Measuring finished parts and comparing them with the technical drawings;
  • Checking the quality of the manufactured parts;
  • Working mainly with 3-axis lathes.

As a CNC SETTER in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have experience setting up CNC-controlled machines;
  • You have a good understanding of reading technical drawings, machining techniques, measurement techniques, and determining tolerances;
  • You can operate an overhead crane or are willing to learn this internally;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client located in DIKSMUIDE, we are looking for a CONSTRUCTION WELDER FIELD.

Our client is a well-known company active in water pumps and water treatment. They are a close-knit team where employees are always the number one priority.

As a CONSTRUCTION WELDER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you will perform the following tasks:

  • Assembling and welding steel structures such as screws, water treatment installations, and other constructions;
  • Building structures according to assembly plans and guidelines;
  • Using various welding techniques: TIG, MIG, and electrode welding;
  • Checking dimensions, shapes, weld seams, and overall quality;
  • Adjusting parts where necessary in case of deformations or defects;
  • Working with different welding machines and, when required, operating equipment such as overhead cranes and aerial work platforms.
As a CONSTRUCTION WELDER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have experience or a diploma as a welder, with knowledge of various welding techniques;
  • You possess all required certificates (mandatory);
  • You have a good understanding of reading technical drawings and using various assembly techniques and equipment;
  • You are able to work independently, are allowed to do so, and take initiative;
  • You have basic knowledge of electrical systems and hydraulics;
  • You have a driving licence B;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client located in DIKSMUIDE, we are looking for a MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER FIELD.

Our client is a well-known company active in water pumps and water treatment. They are a close-knit team where employees are always the number one priority.

As a MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you will perform the following tasks:

  • Installing and assembling screw pumps, water treatment installations, bridges, and other structures on-site;
  • Ensuring the commissioning of these installations or carrying out maintenance work;
  • Performing necessary repairs and renovation works when required;
  • Working mainly in Belgium, with occasional assignments in the Netherlands, France, and Germany;
  • Staying overnight in hotels when required;
  • Working with various welding machines and, when necessary, operating equipment such as overhead cranes and aerial work platforms.
As a MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have a technically oriented diploma with knowledge of welding techniques;
  • You are willing to occasionally stay overnight in a hotel, as the projects are carried out on different locations;
  • You are not afraid of outdoor work and large constructions;
  • You have a good understanding of reading technical drawings and using various assembly techniques and equipment;
  • You are able to work independently and take initiative;
  • You have a driving licence B;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client in Heverlee, we are looking for a new Business Analyst. Do you already have valuable professional experience and are you looking for a new challenge? Then be sure to read on!

Here’s a glimpse of your responsibilities:

• Project Management – Manage the portfolio of ESO IT and business transformation projects, covering prioritisation, planning, stakeholder alignment, risk management, budgeting and successful delivery

• Process Analysis – Identify opportunities for process standardisation, automation and digitalisation to enable scalable business growth

• Requirements Gathering – Develop functional requirements and specifications by translating the commercial and technical needs of business programmes

• Solution Design – Act as the business representative towards IT and Business Systems teams, ensuring solutions meet both current and future business requirements

• Commercial Management – Drive commercial initiatives including supplier management, contract negotiations, pricing and programme tracking

• Business Liaison – Serve as the key day-to-day link between ESO and operational IT and Business Systems teams

• After-Sales Operations – Support commercial and operational after-sales objectives by identifying and implementing opportunities for operational improvement

• Project management: Proven ability to manage projects and programmes and deliver measurable results

• Analytical mindset: Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights

• Commercial awareness: Able to assess business impact and develop clear, well-founded business cases

• Business analysis: Skilled at translating business needs into clear requirements and specifications for technical teams

• Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels

• Collaboration: Strong relationship-building and influencing skills across different departments

• Adaptability: Comfortable managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines

• IT collaboration: Experience working with Business Systems or IT teams

• Languages: Fluent in business English; additional languages are an advantage

• Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience

Senior Project Manager Compliance, Risk & Resilience

 

Are you an experienced Project Manager in risk management, asset management, compliance, business continuity, and organizational resilience? This is a unique opportunity to lead a high-impact transformation program focused on implementing the European Critical Entities Resilience (CER) framework within a major infrastructure environment.

In this strategic role, you will drive the planning, coordination, and execution of initiatives designed to enhance operational resilience, ensure regulatory compliance, and safeguard the continuity of essential services. 🔒⚡

 

🎯 Your Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate the end-to-end implementation of the CER (Critical Entities Resilience) program.
• Translate regulatory requirements into practical actions, projects, and business processes.
• Collaborate with stakeholders across Operations, IT, Security, Risk, Compliance, and Executive Management.
• Drive risk assessments, business continuity planning, and crisis management initiatives.
• Monitor project objectives, timelines, budgets, deliverables, and dependencies.
• Provide regular reporting and updates to senior leadership on program progress, risks, and compliance status.
• Ensure the successful implementation of organizational, technical, and operational resilience measures.
• Promote a culture of resilience, risk awareness, and continuous improvement across the organization.
 

✅ Your Profile

• Minimum 5 years of experience in Project Management, Program Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Business Continuity, Security, or a related field.
• Experience leading organization-wide transformation or change initiatives.
• Strong understanding of risk management, business continuity, and crisis management practices.
• Knowledge of governance, compliance, and regulatory frameworks.
• Affinity with critical infrastructure, operational environments, and security-related topics.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to convert risks into actionable solutions.
• Excellent communication and coordination skills.
• Fluent in Dutch; English is considered a bonus.
 

Ready to make a lasting impact on critical infrastructure resilience? We'd love to hear from you. 🚀

Are you passionate about people, communication, and business development? We are looking for a Junior Sales Advisor to join a well-established and respected financial institution in Belgium. This is an excellent opportunity for a young professional who wants to build a career in a customer-focused and commercial environment.

Client Details

Our client is a leading player in the financial services sector, known for its strong customer orientation, professional development opportunities, and collaborative culture. The company invests heavily in its employees and offers a stable environment where talent can grow and develop.

Description

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.
• Advise clients on products and services that match their needs.
• Support customers throughout their journey and provide excellent service.
• Identify commercial opportunities and contribute to business growth.
• Work closely with colleagues to ensure an outstanding customer experience.
• Participate in client meetings, follow-ups, and sales initiatives.

• Master's degree (field of study is not important).
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Commercial mindset with a genuine interest in sales and customer relationships.
• Proactive, dynamic, and eager to learn.
• Team player with a positive attitude.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

Do you have a strong eye for detail and a structured way of working that ensures high-quality results? Then we are looking for you!
 

At Legend Biotech, you’ll have the chance to make a real difference. Your work will directly contribute to improving the lives of sick patients around the world.
 

No experience yet? No worries, we’ll teach you everything you need to know. Just like we take great care of our patients, we also take care of our employees.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 

 
• You assist with daily quality analyses and help ensure reliable test results.
 
• You check, clean, and disinfect equipment, and manage lab materials and waste.
 
• You ensure safe and accurate sample transfers between departments.
 
• You assist with various analyses in the labs.
 
• You accurately log all your tasks in logs, forms, or the quality system. 

 
• You have a Bachelor's degree in a scientific field, and/or experience in a Quality- related role.
 
• You work detail- oriented with precision.
 
• You have a strong quality- mindset.
 
• You have a clean and accurate working style.
 
• You like to collaborate with others.
 
• You speak English well.
 
• You are comfortable working with a laptop and MS-Office.
 
• You live nearby Ghent and can easily commute to work, even without public transportation.
 
• You are flexible and able to work in shifts.

You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action
• You have some technical insight
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts
• It is a plus if you can operate a forklift

For our client in the ICHTEGEM region, we are looking for a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER.

Our client is a family-owned company specialized in bulk transport, concrete transport, tipper truck transport and traction transport.

As a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER in ICHTEGEM, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Delivering soil and waste materials from earthworks using a tipper truck;
  • Transporting and delivering materials in accordance with safety regulations and applicable instructions;
  • Cleaning the truck;
  • Communicating with customers in a friendly and professional manner;
  • Unloading the truck at construction sites and driving back to reload.
As a CE DRIVER in NIEUWPOORT, you can identify with the following:

  • Experience as a CE DRIVER;
  • You are in possession of a CE driving licence, a valid Code 95 and a driver card;
  • You speak Dutch OR English OR French.

Are you an experienced asphalt worker who enjoys rolling up your sleeves?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced asphalt worker to join our asphalt crew.

What does your job involve?

  • You assist the asphalt crew with the preparation, laying and finishing of hot-mix asphalt;
  • You help ensure the correct distribution and finishing of the asphalt;
  • You are responsible for touching up and finishing asphalt around joints and connections;
  • You help create a smooth and high-quality road surface;
  • You work closely with machine operators, roller operators, drivers and other colleagues on site;
  • You work with modern machinery, techniques and tools;
  • You depart daily from Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience in asphalt works, preferably as an asphalt worker;
  • You have knowledge of the different steps involved in laying and finishing hot-mix asphalt;
  • You are physically fit and enjoy active, hands-on work;
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions;
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English;
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.
